profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Building agentic engineering systems for the Guided product team — agent harnesses, skills, and tooling that let agents navigate the monorepo, run pre-commit gates, drive progressive code review, and close the loop with MR approve-and-handoff automations. Designing agent-native workflows that cut review turnaround and keep humans in the loop where it matters. In parallel, shipping Guided’s multi-vendor education catalog end-to-end: vendor connectors and sync pipelines, Postgres schema and persistence, scheduled ingestion, run diagnostics, and operator admin tooling. Expanding into the eligibility engine that determines which funding and programs families can use, plus browse and admin surfaces on top of the catalog.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - AI Platform
positions.description:
Built a knowledge base for agent tool use enabling citation quality answers in AI-powered workflows
Designed LLM infrastructure and AI platform architecture for climate finance use cases, integrating VoyageAI domain-specific embeddings and Pinecone vector database for high-precision document retrieval
Engineered scalable document ingestion pipeline using Trigger.dev for job orchestration, with webhook processing, idempotency, and artifact versioning — built in TypeScript with Supabase for persistence
Designed and deployed multiple AI agents including document review agents and an environmental impact profiling agent tracking energy, carbon, and water footprint of LLM/Claude Code usage
Led vendor evaluation of AI/ML tooling including LlamaCloud, Databricks, and custom embedding stacks — driving build-vs-buy decisions and agentic AI architecture selection
positions.insights: Skills: Agentic Workflows · Anthropic Claude · TypeScript · trigger.dev

positions.title: Senior Data Scientist
positions.description:
Built and led Session AI product using LLMs for secure healthcare transcriptions and summaries, solving complex data privacy challenges
Developed full-stack triage application for mental healthcare using Streamlit and Snowflake
Engineered provider matching service (Django/GraphQL) improving care quality (10% retention increase), reducing costs ($21/session) and provider churn
Rebuilt pricing calculator in React/TypeScript, dramatically reducing support tickets while adding functionality
Created self-service solution integrating external vendor data with Salesforce
Designed and implemented external-facing APIs with robust documentation
Leveraged LLMs to standardize content, driving 9% CTR improvement
Launched data-driven experiments with rigorous A/B testing methodology
Mentored data scientists on engineering best practices and infrastructure
Led migration to Prefect workflow orchestration, improving reliability and observability

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
Architected and implemented ML-powered benefits navigation system, improving user engagement and resource discovery experience
Mentored data scientists in software engineering best practices, infrastructure design patterns, and deployment workflows
Led comprehensive MLOps initiatives including GraphQL service endpoints, automated model retraining pipelines, Django backend integrations, and high-performance data transformation workflows

positions.title: Python Tutor - FinTech and Data Science
positions.description:
Delivered engaging live coding demonstrations illustrating complex technical concepts and best practices to engineering students
Designed and led technical presentations of advanced topics including APIs, data processing pipelines, ML/NLP systems, cloud architecture (AWS), algorithmic trading models, and blockchain/decentralized applications
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Data Science · Data Analysis · Software Development · Algorithms · Python · Streamlit · SQL · Git

positions.title: Data Engineer - Environmental Assurance and Protection
positions.description:
Led complex global environmental technology projects from requirements gathering to successful launch, managing complete product lifecycle
Orchestrated IoT, software, analytics, and data engineering initiatives including a $1.2M global waste management platform and an automated weather monitoring system for regulatory compliance
Engineered donations management tool decreasing waste disposal costs by $50M annually through innovative technical solutions
Directed AWS ProServe consultants and cross-functional teams while managing technical documentation, stakeholder relationships, and project scope
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analysis · Python · SQL · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Git

positions.title: Software Engineer - Machine Learning and Discovery Algorithms
positions.description:
Engineered high-performance matrix factorization recommendation model with implicit feedback, optimizing collaborative and query-based algorithms
Designed and implemented scalable data pipelines across distributed services and data stores, reducing runtime by 67%
Developed specialized tooling and comprehensive documentation for data scientists, enhancing cross-team collaboration
Optimized memory and storage efficiency through advanced algorithmic improvements and system architecture refinements

positions.title: Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure
positions.description:
Engineered high-performance fraud detection system with predictive ML models and real-time analytics dashboards, while developing custom connectors between Hadoop and Elasticsearch ecosystems
Implemented end-to-end data pipeline architecture using Python, Hive, Elasticsearch, Hadoop, MySQL, Redshift, S3, and workflow orchestration (Pinball)
Built scalable visualization solutions supporting cross-team decision making and system monitoring

positions.title: Android Developer - Payments
positions.description:
Implemented split payments functionality across multiple payment platforms, enabling installment payments and driving conversion increase
Built robust integration services connecting diverse payment systems using Java, Ruby, MySQL, and Android SDK
Delivered high-performance, fault-tolerant payment processing system with comprehensive testing and monitoring

positions.title: Data Engineer - Data Products and Infrastructure
positions.description:
Engineered extensible data infrastructure with custom operators and hooks for diverse data sources, enabling seamless ETL workflows
Designed and implemented core/aggregate data architecture patterns supporting critical business intelligence systems
Built production Airflow DAGs and pipelines in collaboration with data scientists, optimizing for performance and reliability
Developed abstraction layers enabling non-technical analysts to independently create and manage workflows
Created technical training program teaching programming fundamentals and data tooling to analysts
Drove cross-functional collaboration to gather requirements, manage scope, and deliver solutions meeting stakeholder needs
Leveraged Python, Ruby, Hadoop ecosystem (Hive), MySQL, S3, pandas, scikit-learn, Airflow, and Superset to build scalable data systems

positions.title: Expert in Residence - Data Science
positions.description:
Developed and delivered advanced technical curriculum on machine learning systems, focusing on production-ready implementation practices
Designed practical engineering assessments evaluating code quality, algorithm efficiency, and system architecture decisions
Mentored engineers on building robust ML pipelines with Python, pandas, scikit-learn, numpy, OpenCV and deep learning frameworks
Created hands-on technical workshops bridging theoretical concepts with practical engineering implementations
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Data Science · Data Analysis · Python · Pandas (Software) · SQL · Apache Airflow · Git

positions.description:
Architected scalable data infrastructure including ETL pipelines, batch processing systems, and MapReduce frameworks powering critical business intelligence

Developed search and recommendation engines with custom scoring API for query feature extraction and results reranking

Built end-to-end data systems using Python, Hadoop ecosystem (Hive), MySQL, Redshift, S3, workflow orchestration (Pinball), and visualization tools (Chartio, Tableau)

projects.title: Canary
projects.description:
Created Canary, a responsive web application that empowers cooks to identify gluten in existing recipes, and to swap out these ingredients for healthy alternatives, with a focus on optimizing results. To create this project, I wrote a scraper in Python to gather recipes, designed a data model, wrote sorting and conversion algorithms in Javascript, incorporated Yummly and Openrecipes API calls, used Elasticsearch and AngularJS for UX, employed Grunt and Express for development, and created custom graphics and styles.
Learn more here: http://slides.com/marswilliams/canary#/
Read the documentation here: https://github.com/MarsWilliams/canary
